1\. Explicit env file loses precedence 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
load_dotenv now merges the explicit path before .flaskenv and .env, so later dict.update
calls overwrite conflicting values from --env-file. This contradicts the CLI contract that the
explicit file takes precedence over both default files.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The explicit dotenv path is merged before default files, allowing `.flaskenv` or `.env` to overwrite values that must have explicit-file precedence. ## Issue Context The `--env-file` option documents that its values take precedence over `.env` and `.flaskenv`. Preserve the existing `.env` over `.flaskenv` ordering while merging the explicit path after both defaults, and add a conflicting-key regression test. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/cli.py[743-756] - tests/test_cli.py[558-566] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
